mentions.name: Pickpedia
mentions.description: A free web application for cataloging guitars, amps, and pedals, recording each service performed on the gear, and tracking when items were bought or sold. Currently seeking beta users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a web application to catalog your guitars and amps and pedals and record each time you service them and when you bought or sold them.
It’s a free service and I’m looking for BETA users to try it out.
